name: 3nin-me no Raison D'être
source:
There was once a young girl from a noble family.
She lived a carefree life that anyone would envy, blessed and loved by those around her.
That blissful life of hers one day came to an abrupt end.

A military coup d'etat occurred.
Her family was accused of injustice and attacked, causing her to lose both her home and her family at the same time.

The lone survivor, she began a new life in a remote village.

And after several years had come and gone, she made a decision.

She resolved to kill the one who shot down her mother with her own two hands.
And she would do anything to make it happen.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27988]Freem![/url]]
translation:
从前有一个贵族家庭的年轻女孩。
她过着无忧无虑的生活，让任何人都羡慕、被周围的人祝福和喜爱。
有一天，她的幸福生活戛然而止。

发生了军事政变。
她的家人受到不公正的指控和袭击，使她同时失去了家园和家人。

作为唯一的幸存者，她在一个偏远的村庄开始了新的生活。

几年过去了，她做出了一个决定。

她决心用自己的两只手杀死那个射杀她母亲的人。
她愿意做任何事情来实现这一目标。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27988]Freem![/url]]
